credentials_policy: anonymous public HTTP only; no search credential or GitHub token
network_policy: query public APIs and immutable raw metadata only; never clone, fetch, update, build dependencies, or mutate .lake
exploratory_query_boundary: Exploratory anonymous queries run before this file was frozen receive no negative-evidence credit. Every HTTP result cited by the anchor ledger must come from a post-freeze replay of this protocol.
canonical_target: forall {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsLocalRing R] (I : Ideal R), I != top -> (iInf fun n : Nat => I ^ n) = bottom
aliases: intersection of powers of an ideal
namespace_and_type_queries: (iInf fun n : Nat => I ^ n) = bottom
search_order: repository-local Lean sources outside the target-owned audit outputs
all locally materialized lake-manifest packages at their pinned revisions
the pinned mathlib source and git history
official or primary public Lean formalization repositories
other public Lean repositories through anonymous GitHub repository and code search
historical Lean lineage attached to any selected terminal declaration
public_query_plan: GitHub repositories: quoted Krull intersection theorem plus Lean
GitHub repositories: quoted Krull intersection plus Lean4
GitHub code: exact declaration name with language Lean

selection_rules.exact: All ring, Noetherian, local, ideal, properness, natural-power intersection, and zero-ideal components are preserved; binder reordering is permitted only through a kernel-checked zero-strengthening adapter.
selection_rules.supporting: A stronger finite-module or Jacobson-radical statement must have an explicit checked specialization path to the exact ideal root.
selection_rules.mismatch: A domain-only, maximal-ideal-only, completion, Hausdorff, or other strict special case is not the target.
selection_rules.deduplication: Aliases, wrappers, consumers, and supporting theorems sharing the same terminal proof path count once.
selection_rules.proof_credit: A declaration name, type, search hit, inaccessible result, or upstream-only anchor never receives accepted M0 or theorem-completion credit.

negative_evidence_policy: Record exact query, time window, HTTP status, response SHA-256, total count when parseable, and limitations. An access failure is a limitation, never a zero-result claim.
